title: ephor answer envelope
description: What a summoned command may write to the file named by $EPHOR_ANSWER (FS-006-project-interface.4). The exit code is always authoritative (0 done, non-zero failed, 75 parked); this envelope is optional structure on top. Every field is optional; unknown fields are ignored (must-ignore). Fields that describe 'the matter of this summons' (gate, failures, features, summary, url, needs_response) need no matter key: the summons's EPHOR_* environment already names it. Sources reporting more than one subject use matters/discussions/events with explicit keys.

v.description: Envelope version. Bumps only on incompatible change (FS-006-project-interface.11).

summary.description: One line about the matter of this summons. Read by checks, custom-status.

url.description: Where a person would look. Read by custom-status, ci.status.

needs_response.description: Source's hint that the matter awaits the person. ephor's own calculus (FS-003-feed-categories.4) governs where it applies; this hint stands where only the source can know.

gate.description: The gate of the matter of this summons. Read by ci.status (FS-006-project-interface.6).

failures.description: What actually failed for the matter of this summons. Read by ci.failures and by check verbs (FS-006-project-interface.5, .6).

matters.description: Subjects this command reports (FS-007-matters). Read by task stores and custom-status.

discussions.description: Message groups this command reports, attributed by their matter key or to the matter of this summons.

channels.description: Capability declarations for channels named by discussions (FS-007-matters.4). Declared once here, not per discussion.

data.description: Free passthrough. Returns wherever the dossier's metadata goes (EPHOR_RAW, {meta.*}).

key.description: The stated subject key (FS-007-matters.1): 'gh:owner/repo#123', 'ticket:GR-73955', a store's own id such as 'rhei:panta/plan.3' or 'bead:a1f3'. Grammar: '<scheme>:<forge-stated id>'. Never synthesized from a title.

state.description: State as the source spells it ('open', 'open:needs_work', 'merged', 'In Progress').

terminal.description: Whether the state is final as the source understands finality (closed, merged, resolved). Drives Recent (FS-003-feed-categories.2).

branch.description: Head branch name, for workspace resolution.

refs.description: Referenced subject keys or ticket keys — link evidence (FS-007-matters.2, FS-008-attribution).

reasons.description: Why this is the person's: authored, engaged, cited, review-requested, assigned (FS-001-forge-interface.1).

matter.description: Subject key this discussion belongs to. Omitted: the matter of this summons.

channel.description: Channel id this discussion lives in (e.g. 'review-threads', 'comments', 'mail'). Omitted: the source's single implicit channel.

label.description: Rendered over the thread where several exist.

mine.description: Whether the configured user wrote it. Decided by the source — only it knows how the venue identifies people.

task.description: Present where the venue tracks this message as a task (FS-003-feed-categories.4).
Task on a message. 'state' is ephor's; every other property is the source's own resolve descriptor, handed back verbatim when the person ticks the box (FS-004-quick-actions.5).

can.description: Declared write capabilities (FS-007-matters.4). Absent capability: display-only, and the surfaces offer no key.

matter.description: Subject key. Omitted: the matter of this summons.

state.description: For kind 'state': the state arrived at.

repos.description: Counts per repository the gate covers — one change may gate across a tree (FS-001-forge-interface.1, AR-004-forest.1).

blocked.description: Whether the forge or gate refuses the merge regardless of counts — approvals, jobs never started (FS-001-forge-interface.1).

blockers.description: The gate's own reasons, as sentences.

job.description: The job or build a reader would recognize ('build 4711', 'style-gate').

repo.description: Repository of the forest it failed in, where the gate spans several.

trace.description: The error text itself, where it can be extracted.

log.description: Path to a log file written by this command, relative to its working directory.

jobs.description: How many jobs hit this identical failure, where deduplicated (FS-004-quick-actions.4).

paths.description: Globs relating the feature to source paths, for change-driven selection.
